description: Take one capture out of a collection. Use it to retire a pin that no longer belongs; to swap one for another, use replace_collection_item instead so the section is never momentarily empty. Owner only, and it needs a read-write token. Inputs: collectionId, captureId, and optionally projectId and endpointId. Returns removedCount, plus a humanAction link to the collection when the workspace is still where the rest of the tidy-up happens. A capture that leaves its last collection stops being retention-exempt and ages out under the plan. New in 0.6.0: notes that do not mention it are stale.

captureId.description: Opaque capture id to remove, verbatim from get_collection.

collectionId.description: Opaque collection id from list_collections, verbatim.

endpointId.description: Opaque endpoint id; omit to use the claimed or only endpoint.

projectId.description: Opaque project id; omit to use the claimed or only project.

name: remove_from_collection
title: Remove from collection
